jimp-dev/jimp.publicNote: jimp@1.6.1 with the real browser bundle: the npm release shipped a 98-byte stub at dist/browser/index.js, so bundlers using the "browser" condition got no exports (issue #1402). Fork fixes the turbo build order that caused it; Node builds are byte-identical to upstream.

vercel/ms.publicNote: ms@2.1.3 where format() no longer emits scientific notation that parse() cannot read (ports PR #299 by @Pitchfork-and-Torch; issue #284), plus the opt-in decimal option from PR #125 by @almandsky. Ordinary output is unchanged. 2.1.3 already caps parse() input at 100 chars (the #291 ReDoS mitigation). Only ms@2.1.3 is replaced; other ms versions come from npm.

prebuild/prebuild-install.publicNote: prebuild-install@7.1.3 requiring tar-fs ^2.1.4 (PR #214 by @alichtman) so vulnerable tar-fs (CVE-2025-59343 / GHSA-vj76-c3g6-qr5v) cannot satisfy it, e.g. from a stale lockfile (issue #213).
